description: Explicitly ingest content from a URL, optionally crawling same-domain links. Use only when the user asks to ingest that URL.

depth.description: Crawl depth. Zero ingests only the supplied page.

project.description: Optional project ID. Defaults to the repository-scoped project.

same_domain_only.description: Restrict recursive crawling to the starting domain. Default is true.

name: cuemap_ingest_url
